title: CostReport
description: PRD §6.1 minimum resource-cost reporting, emitted by ats/profile.py (Phase 4). Required fields are the PRD §6.1 minimum; cpu_pct and energy_estimate_j are reported 'where feasible' per the PRD and so are optional.

config_id.description: Which configuration this report describes, e.g. 'full', 'quant8', 'pruned', 'distilled'.

target_device.description: Frozen in TASKS.md §0. Must be stated verbatim, e.g. 'Laptop CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5800H (8C/16T), 16GB RAM, Windows 11 64-bit, single-process CPU inference'.

params.description: Parameter count of the model(s) involved in answering a query.

disk_mb.description: On-disk size of the model artifact(s), in megabytes.

peak_rss_mb.description: Peak resident memory used during inference, in megabytes.

latency_p50_ms.description: Median time to answer a single query, in milliseconds.

latency_p95_ms.description: 95th-percentile time to answer a single query, in milliseconds.

energy_estimate_j.description: Optional. Estimated energy spent per query, in joules.
